intent: Preserve already-established all-away evidence and the remaining absence cooldown through Home Assistant restart; prevent empty-room presence cooldown from overwriting directly verified Away from selected Persons, trackers or numeric home counts.
note: Fresh positive Home evidence always wins; unavailable/stale/unknown selected sources cannot establish Away. Preserve native climate/PID modes, device-source permissions, compressor holds, windows, no double domain/migration and previous beta50 effective presets.
changes: Fix home_presence precedence: any fresh positive selected source means Home, any unknown among required selected sources keeps unknown; fully verified explicit home trackers (including numeric zero counts) return Away immediately even if occupied-room list's cooldown restarted after HA reboot.

Require exact same selected source identifiers/attribute and fresh negative readings to resume a persisted interval. Drop evidence after verified home arrival or source edit; retain it but do not claim Away during unknown/offline data.

When multiple selected room sources contribute to absence, start the cooldown from the last source to become negative. Rebuild climate plans and climate-only per-device fallback using the same trusted evidence.

Add regressions for restart state timestamp reset, resumed and still-pending cooldown, numeric and Person Away precedence, unknown/positive fail-closed, configuration changes, source timestamp uncertainty and no physical actuation.
